segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ בֶּן תֵּשַׁע שָׁנִים וְיוֹם אֶחָד שֶׁבָּא עַל יְבִמְתּוֹ, וְאַחַר כָּךְ בָּא עָלֶיהָ אָחִיו שֶׁהוּא בֶּן תֵּשַׁע שָׁנִים וְיוֹם אֶחָד — פּוֹסַל עַל יָדוֹ. רַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן אוֹמֵר: לֹא פָּסַל. בֶּן תֵּשַׁע שָׁנִים וְיוֹם אֶחָד שֶׁבָּא עַל יְבִמְתּוֹ, וְאַחַר כָּךְ בָּא עַל צָרָתָהּ — פָּסַל עַל יְדֵי עַצְמוֹ. רַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן אוֹמֵר: לֹא פָּסַל.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» If a boy «aged nine years and one day had» sexual «relations with his yevama, and afterward his brother, who is» also «nine years and one day old, had relations with her,» the second brother «disqualifies» her «to» the first one. «Rabbi Shimon says» he does «not disqualify» her. If a minor «aged nine years and one day had relations with his yevama, and afterward» that same boy «had relations with her rival wife,» he thereby «disqualifies her to himself,» and both women are now forbidden to him. «Rabbi Shimon says» he does «not disqualify» her.
